title: Pumpkin Trinket Jar (2 parts)
description: A lobed pumpkin that splits in the middle: a hollow base with a lid topped by a curly stem. Great for rings, candy-wrapped surprises, pins or paperclips.
use: Trinket jar, seasonal desk decoration, small gift box.
material: PLA or PETG, 0.2 mm layers. Orange/silk filament looks great. Lid lip: 0.25 mm radial clearance (slip fit).

parts.lid: pumpkin top with stem and inner lip

fit_notes: Lid lip 0.25 mm radial clearance (slip fit).
